description: Windowless DWM startup with widgets enabled by a test overlay derived from assets/dwm/default.toml. Production defaults remain unchanged. Run: python3 tools/test_dwm_window_actions.py --scene boot [--uefi]. The helper preserves these assertions, builds through qemu_test.py, waits for gui_server: desktop ready and captures the desktop.
